in_marathi.name: Balli
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of Fortress
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balli is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'balla' meaning fort. This name is often given to a girl who is believed to be strong and protective, like a fortress. In Hindu mythology, Balli is also associated with the goddess Durga, who is the embodiment of strength and protection.
